pages.text: This is a heavy pack. Give the game at least $(bold)8 GB of RAM$() (set in your launcher's instance settings). About 10 GB is more comfortable with Distant Horizons.

$(bold)Distant Horizons$() draws far-away terrain as simplified chunks so you can see much further than normal render distance. It is useful for airships and the Moon, but costs memory and some frame rate. Turn its settings down first if the game stutters.

$(bold)Shaders$() are included and run through Iris. Open Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs to pick one.$(br2)$(li)Complementary Reimagined, with Euphoria Patches$(br)$(li)Bliss$(br)$(li)Photon$(br)$(li)Solas
Shaders are optional and can cut frame rate a lot on weaker machines. First world creation is also slow because of how many mods add world generation. This settles after the first load.

$(bold)Chunksmith$() pregenerates terrain on demand. Its automatic pregeneration on world entry is switched off here: the default (a 4096-block radius every time you join) can take many hours on a weaker PC. Use the $(bold)/chunksmith$() commands when you want terrain ready ahead of an airship or train.

pages.title: Distant Horizons
pages.text: Shows far terrain as simplified chunks. Handy from an airship, a submarine or the Moon.
